stories.title: Ex-CIA official accused of stealing US$40 million in gold bars pleads guilty

en.title: Ex-CIA official accused of stealing US$40 million in gold bars pleads guilty
en.summary: A former senior CIA official pleaded guilty to abusing his position and government funds to acquire luxury Florida real estate and over US$40 million in gold bars for personal profit. He fabricated a classified government programme to justify the acquisitions.

stories.title: After cordial Xi-Trump summit, could China’s US dollar pivot cause tremors?

en.title: After cordial Xi-Trump summit, could China's US dollar pivot cause tremors?
en.summary: China has been gradually reducing its US Treasury holdings while promoting wider global use of the yuan and developing alternative financial systems. These monetary shifts may have implications despite not being explicitly discussed at the recent Xi-Trump summit.

stories.title: US seeks US$100 million bail each for Chinese-born couple in surrogacy child abuse case

en.title: US seeks US$100 million bail each for Chinese-born couple in surrogacy child abuse case
en.summary: A Chinese-born couple in California faces charges of conspiring to abuse children born through surrogacy arrangements. Prosecutors allege they directed nannies to physically punish the children and used surveillance to monitor the abuse.

stories.title: Christa Pike conscious and speaking after Tennessee failed execution

en.title: Christa Pike conscious and speaking after Tennessee failed execution
en.summary: A Tennessee inmate who survived an execution attempt is now conscious and speaking while receiving hospital care. Her legal representatives described her recovery as medically unprecedented despite severe injuries.

stories.title: Can’t Uygurs drink Starbucks and taste American freedom?

en.title: Can't Uygurs drink Starbucks and taste American freedom?
en.summary: A U.S. House committee chairman called on Starbucks to close two stores it opened in Urumqi, Xinjiang, citing concerns about the region.

stories.title: Trump says Iran could ‘take out’ Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing backlash

en.title: Trump says Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing backlash
en.summary: During a Nebraska rally, President Trump suggested Iran could attack major U.S. cities, prompting criticism from Democratic leaders and some Republicans.

stories.title: EU wants to track potential rogue efforts to block out the sun

en.title: EU wants to track potential rogue efforts to block out the sun
en.summary: The European Union allocated €35 million to fund research on detecting and coordinating responses to unauthorized attempts at solar radiation modification technology.

en.title: Live broadcast external link: National Day return peak underway! Cloud-viewing traffic conditions together
en.summary: Coverage of traffic conditions during the National Day holiday return period is being provided through live broadcast.

stories.title: 澜湄合作专项基金支持泰缅边境洪水预警项目

en.title: Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Special Fund supports Thailand-Myanmar border flood early warning project
en.summary: Thailand will receive funding from the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Special Fund to implement water resource cooperation projects with Myanmar, including flood early warning systems for border areas, aimed at strengthening disaster response capabilities.

stories.title: Empowering a sustainable future: International Gas Union summit to be held in Hong Kong this October

en.title: Empowering a sustainable future: International Gas Union summit to be held in Hong Kong this October
en.summary: The International Gas Union Council 2026 and sustainability summit will take place in Hong Kong this month, providing a platform for leaders to discuss global energy security and price trends amid geopolitical uncertainties.

stories.title: CFA中国之队·重庆国际足球邀请赛：中国队一胜三负收官

en.title: CFA China Team Chongqing International Football Invitational: China team finishes with one win and three losses
en.summary: China's national football team concluded the 2026 CFA Chongqing International Football Invitational with a 0-1 loss to Tajikistan, ending the tournament with a record of one win and three defeats.

stories.title: Hong Kong land sale stuns market as HK$4.3b bid hits 5-year Kowloon high

en.title: Hong Kong land sale stuns market as HK$4.3b bid hits 5-year Kowloon high
en.summary: Kerry Properties purchased a residential land plot in Ho Man Tin for HK$4.31 billion, marking the highest price for a Kowloon residential site in nearly five years. The sale price reflects strong developer confidence in luxury home demand.

stories.title: As China’s AI race accelerates, ‘model fatigue’ becomes the next challenge

en.title: As China's AI race accelerates, 'model fatigue' becomes the next challenge
en.summary: Multiple major technology companies released new artificial intelligence models within hours in September, including Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6, Anthropic's Opus 5.5, and OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna models. The rapid release pace is creating challenges for executives and developers attempting to track developments.

stories.title: China’s Transsion, Africa’s top phone maker, targets US$500 million Hong Kong listing

en.title: China's Transsion, Africa's top phone maker, targets US$500 million Hong Kong listing
en.summary: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings, which makes Africa's best-selling phones, is launching a Hong Kong share offering this week to raise up to US$500 million, with listing targeted for October 15. The company already trades in Shanghai with a market capitalisation of 62 billion yuan.

stories.title: Mox, BOCHK, ZA Bank and Citibank apps land among Asia-Pacific’s 10 best, study says

en.title: Mox, BOCHK, ZA Bank and Citibank apps land among Asia-Pacific's 10 best, study says
en.summary: Banking applications from Mox Bank, Bank of China Hong Kong, ZA Bank and Citibank Hong Kong ranked among the top 10 in Asia-Pacific according to an assessment by Sia consulting firm evaluating 145 banking apps across functionality and user experience.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s Hermitage Capital stays devoted to top-tier tech stocks amid jitters

en.title: Hong Kong's Hermitage Capital stays devoted to top-tier tech stocks amid jitters
en.summary: Hong Kong-based Hermitage Capital is continuing its global investment strategy in frontier technology companies despite market volatility, deploying its US$1.5 billion fund across artificial intelligence, semiconductors and robotics primarily in the US and China.
